QuestInfo.name: Spill It, Headmaster!
QuestInfo.0: You learn that you can become a member of the Resistance once you increase your level increases, but you don't really know how that works... Maybe the school headmaster will know. Go see #b#p2152000##k, who's standing in front of the school.
QuestInfo.1:
The headmaster kindly explains that your level will naturally increase as you gain more experience while helping the various people around town. Go #bhelp townspeople in need.#k

QuestInfo.2: You helped the townspeople, returned to the school headmaster, and your level increased! As you wondered what to do next, you recalled that the Resistance is supposed to contact you. All you can do now is wait...

0.0:
Why, hello there, young #h0#. There's no school today, so what brings you here? Are you having trouble with your homework? Perhaps I can help. 

#L0##bI need to get to Level 10 quick! I figured you'd know how, Headmaster.#k#l
0.1:
(Headmaster Ferdi runs a hand along his bushy beard.) 
Level 10, eh? You must be the one that-- Ah, nevermind. Sure, I can help. Leveling up is easy. All you have to do is gain some life and combat experience. 
#L0##bLife and combat experience? You mean EXP? Well, how am I supposed to do that?#k#l
0.2: There are many ways, but I suggest you start by helping the citizens of Edelstein, #h0#. Talk to people who need help and offer them a hand. You'll level up to 10 in no time. How's that sound?

yes.0: Very good, very good. #bGo talk to the residents of Edelstein and see how you can help them#k. Just about everyone in town could use a helping hand, but I recommend you start with #b#p2152001#, the Kindergarten Teacher#k, since he's nearby.

no.0: Well, if you don't like the idea of helping others, you can head left and find some monsters around your level. Eliminating them will reward you some EXP, but I heartily recommended helping the townspeople first. That will reward you far more experience.

1.0:
Ah, you're back, young #h0#! And how do you feel? Did you enjoy helping others? 
#L0##bIt's such a rush to help people! Already, Edelstein seems like a brighter place to live.#l
#L1#Ugh, I don't know why people keep asking me for help. Read my lips: SO not interested.#l
#L2#Meh, whatever. I want to take a nap now.#l
#k
1.1: (The Headmaster smiles at you, a twinkle in his eye.) \r\nI suspected you might feel that way, #h0#.

0.1: Did you not find it rewarding, #h0#? Bringing other people joy is a reward in and of itself.
0.2: Yes, you must be exhausted. Why don't you get some rest and return when you've recharged your energy?

quest.0: There are still folks who could use your help. Check your #bQuest Window#k to make sure you haven't forgotten anyone.
